provenance: Synthetic, non-production security fixtures for issue #388

cases.label: false_positive
cases.title: Weak algorithm pattern on a non-security checksum
cases.description: The detector matched sha1.New, but the digest is only a stable cache key and is not used for authentication or integrity.

cases.label: false_positive
cases.title: Dynamic RegExp pattern is actually constant
cases.description: The rule reported a dynamic regular expression, but the pattern is a module constant.
cases.source:
const SAFE_SLUG = '^[a-z0-9-]+$';
export const validSlug = value => new RegExp(SAFE_SLUG).test(value);
